block.connectedstorage.item_pipe.tooltip: Carries an _Item Pump_'s link to _Item Vaults_ and _Item Silos_. A pump reaches _1 pipe block per 16 RPM_, up to 16.
When part of a pumped network
Every storage the pipes and pumps reach shares _one inventory_. Pipes beyond a pump's reach, or without a running pump, do nothing.
block.connectedstorage.item_pump.tooltip: Merges the _Item Vaults_ and _Item Silos_ connected to it into _one shared inventory_. Connects on both ends, directly to storages or through _Item Pipes_.
Reaches _1 pipe block per 16 RPM_, up to _16 at 256 RPM_. Funnels, chutes and packagers on _any_ reached storage can reach _every_ reached storage. Use another pump to go further.
The storages split apart again. Items stay where they are.
